reason: OLLA formulates tensor lifetime and placement optimization to reduce neural-network memory, but the abstract and conclusion frame the method around training models and its experiments measure training memory/runtime. Inference is mentioned in related work, not evaluated as OLLA's target. The main reported 30.4%/36.1% peak-memory reduction is for training workloads, so this is outside the inference-efficiency scope.
title: OLLA: Optimizing the Lifetime and Location of Arrays to Reduce the Memory Usage of Neural Networks
